summary: Every legal input is at most 1000 and therefore has at most ten binary digits, so the construction has a fixed operation bound too small for an honest runtime-scaling verdict.

workload_bound.source_constraint: n is an integer from 1 through 1000

replacement_checks.evidence: The reference reads the at-most-ten-bit length, shifts one bit by that fixed amount, and subtracts one.
Authored cases cover all-ones inputs and both sides of every relevant power-of-two bit-length transition through the maximum input.
